entries.source_section_or_line: fit_gamma -- precision claim in ERR-HU-022, suspended by ERR-HU-024
entries.old_statement: gamma's precision is void because the estimator returns sd 0.544 on pure noise (ERR-HU-022)
entries.corrected_statement: REFUTED by a recovery test at the real n (C-T28).  Feeding the estimator ARFIMA sign series with a KNOWN gamma, at the real per-day counts and through the identical pipeline, it returns sd 0.019-0.033 -- typical 0.023-0.029, some twenty times tighter than the pure-noise null suggested.  ERR-HU-022's precision claim is WITHDRAWN; ERR-HU-024's suspension resolves in that direction.  Two further findings come out of the same run and neither was visible before: (1) the estimator carries a systematic SHRINKAGE toward about 0.45 -- true 0.20 returns 0.282, true 0.60 returns 0.559 -- so every published gamma must be de-biased by inverting that curve; de-biased values are 0.381 / 0.347 / 0.374, and they are distinguishable from the book's 0.5 at z 2.9-4.4.  (2) BTC and ETH's gammas are NOT distinguishable from each other (z 0.83), so C-T25's premise that they agree is CONFIRMED rather than undermined -- which sharpens Sec 489's tension instead of dissolving it.  ERR-HU-022's other content (the pure-noise null is n-independent; the levels were never void) is unaffected.
